summary: There are no ship powers in flight yet. The galaxy flight scene (src/components/galaxy/scene.js) has one gun per crew: KEYS at :140 is W/S/A/D, the arrows, Space/Shift and F; onKeyDown at :1945-1999 adds M (map), J (jump), V (cockpit), F (fire), T/Q (target) and E/Enter (land); Esc is handled by pages/Galaxy.jsx:345-358; O (flight settings) by universe/FlightSettings.jsx:36; '?' by Guide.jsx:53. The galaxy has no weapon switching, but the guide's shared FLY rows advertise 'R / 1 2 3' for /galaxy (guide/pages.js:19,122). The universe map (universe/scene.js) adds R/1/2/3 weapons (weapons.js: blaster, spread, and heavy rounds named Proton torpedoes / Concussion missiles / Portal grenades / Fulminated mercury, :29-33), H for the hangar and G at the phone (:4642). On foot it has its own keys (B, X, G…). So G and X are free in flight on both maps (G only clashes next to the universe map's phone). There are exactly four crews, pinned by crews.test.js:7-9: cruiser (Rick, Morty), xwing (Luke, R2), falcon (Han, Chewie) and rv (Walt, Jesse) (crews.js:20-2895; who leads each is in heroes.js:68). On foot, abilities already work: surface/abilityRules.js holds ABILITIES cards { name, about, cool, numbers } with abilitiesOf(spec). surface/scene.js:1380-1470 plays them on G/V with cooldown timestamps, and GalaxySurface.jsx:538-555 draws G/V/X tiles with a sweeping cooldown overlay (surface.css:777-795). Rick's on-foot 'hop' and Walt's 'fulminate' are natural echoes of the flight powers below. Everything a power needs already has a hook: hunters (universe/hunters.js and hunterRules.js: hit/damage/targets, sensing, a laser-on-you test at :965, firing at :927), the battle (universe/battle.js through galaxy/warfront.js: hit/targets, the shared objective tally), the galaxy fx pools (fx.js bolts.fire with onHit, flashes.at), crash.js arrive() (green portal swirl for the cruiser, hyperspace ring for the others), the shared post-process effects (aberration, exposure, flare), and clips that fit almost every power (useTheForce, neverTellOdds, chewieRoar/chewieLaugh, wubba, riggity, portalGun, yeahScience, sayMyName, goddamnRight, forceIsStrong). The design: a new pure, tested module universe/shipPowers.js (shared by both maps) with a POWERS table, CREW_POWERS (primary on G with a cooldown, ultimate on X charged by kills) and a ready/active/cooling/charging state machine with geometry helpers; small tested hooks in hunterRules.js and battle.js/warfront.js; glue in galaxy/scene.js; a powerFx.js drawing module; a PowerBar.jsx HUD with touch buttons; crew lines in crews.js through linesFor('power'); a 'power' branch in Comms. The powers: Luke 'Force Focus' and a proton torpedo salvo; Han 'Never tell me the odds' and Chewie on the quad guns; Rick's portal gun and the 'Wubba lubba dub dub' death ray; Walt and Jesse's 'Magnets' and 'Say my name'. Nothing needs to sync online. I wrote a working prototype of the rules and checked it (scratchpad/powers/shipPowers.js plus check.mjs, all assertions pass). Measured numbers: Force Focus cuts hits taken in a 5 s window from 9 to 1 over 20 seeded 4-TIE fights; the RV's 22-unit magnet grabs 120/120 live hunters at the press and pulls 119/120 inside the 10-unit blast within 4 s (combo.mjs). In a fight, hunters sit at a median of 7.5-9 units from you (p90 15-17) and a pack's radius is about 8-10 units (sim.mjs). These numbers set the radii. The baseline tests are green (6 files, 117 tests) and no tracked file was edited.

rootCauses.title: The galaxy guide advertises weapon keys the galaxy doesn't have
rootCauses.mechanism: guide/pages.js shares FLY between /universe and /galaxy. FLY includes ['R / 1 2 3', 'Weapons: blaster, spread, heavy ordnance'], but the galaxy scene has no armory and handles no R or digit keys, so the controls guide promises keys that do nothing. Fix it while adding the G/X rows.
rootCauses.evidence: guide/pages.js:19 (row in FLY) and :122 (/galaxy uses ...FLY); galaxy/scene.js:140 KEYS has no r or digits; onKeyDown :1945-1999 handles only m, j, v, f, t/q, e/enter; grep for pickWeapon/createArmory/key === 'r' in galaxy/scene.js finds nothing. The galaxy's own first-flight hint (GalaxyView.jsx:222-231) correctly leaves weapons out.

proposals.title: Pure rules module universe/shipPowers.js (shared by both maps)
proposals.description:
New src/components/universe/shipPowers.js, mirroring abilityRules.js (cards of numbers plus a per-owner pair). The prototype is at scratchpad/powers/shipPowers.js.

Exports:
- POWER_KEYS {primary:'g', ultimate:'x'}.
- CHARGE {kill 0.2, ace 0.5, objective 0.3, hit 0.02, second 1/150}: 5 kills or 2.5 min of flying fill the ultimate.
- POWERS by id {crew, slot, name, short, about, cool?, dur, …numbers}. All eight cards with their numbers are in proposals 2-5.
- CREW_POWERS {xwing:{primary:'focus',ultimate:'salvo'}, falcon:{'odds','quad'}, cruiser:{'portal','wubba'}, rv:{'magnets','heisenberg'}} and powersOf(crew).

State machine:
- createPowers(crew,{charge}) returns {crew, primary:{id, phase:'ready'|'active'|'cooling', left}, ultimate:{id, phase:'charging'|'ready'|'active', charge, left}}, or null for no crew.
- press(st, slot) returns {ok,id} or {ok:false, why:'active'|'cooling'|'charging'|'none'}. Pressing the ultimate zeroes its charge.
- step(st, dt, {flying}) returns events [{type:'end'|'ready', slot, id}]. A primary goes active → cooling for `cool` → ready. An ultimate goes active → charging. Flying adds the passive charge.
- gain(st, what, n) returns true the moment the meter fills. It is ignored while the ultimate is active, so an ultimate's own kills never charge it.
- cancel(st) ends whatever is active (shot down, crash, jump).
- mods(st) returns {slow, assist, track, cadence, ghost, turn, agility} for the scene to apply.
- view(st) gives the HUD {id, name, short, key, phase, k (0..1 of cooldown left or charge missing), left (s), charge}.

Geometry helpers (pure):
- pickTargets(ship, targets, {count, cone, range}): threats inside the cone first, then nearest the nose, each once; with nothing in the cone, the nearest in range.
- portalExit(ship, target, P, solids, {edge}): `behind` units behind the target along its velocity (or beyond it from you when it's still), facing it. With no target, `hop` units along the nose. Pushed out of solids with hunterRules.clearOf and kept inside edge-5.
- crossesShell(a, b, r).
- beamOf(ship, length).
- blastPunch(d, P): linear from `punch` at the middle to `edge` at the rim, 0 past it.
- pullStep(pos, at, speed, dt): never overshoots.
- jinkStep(t, dt, P, side) → {step, roll}: the sidestep totals `jink` units and the roll totals spins·2π, quickest in the middle.
- turretPick(ship, targets, range, prevId): keeps its current target while in range, else threats weighted 0.4× distance.

Imports only ./targeting (nose, bearing, aimAngles) and ./hunterRules (clearOf). No three.js.
proposals.tests:
shipPowers.test.js (Vitest, Node), following scratchpad/powers/check.mjs:
- Every CREWS id has a primary with cool > 0 and an ultimate; an unknown crew gets null.
- press while charging, active or cooling is refused with the reason.
- Focus is active for 5 s, then cooling for 22 s, then ready, with 'end' and 'ready' events.
- 4 kills don't fill the ultimate and the 5th does (gain returns true).
- Kills during the ultimate don't charge it; cancel ends it into 'charging'.
- 150 s of flying fills it; step with flying:false does not.
- mods: slow 0.35 only while focus is on; ghost while odds or portal is on.
- view keys are 'G' and 'X'; k falls from 1 to 0 across a cooldown.
- pickTargets puts the threat in the cone first, skips targets behind you, and falls back to the nearest.
- portalExit lands 5 behind a target moving +x and faces +x (heading -π/2); a hop at a planet ends outside r+1; edge clamping works.
- crossesShell; blastPunch(0)=10, (10)=3, (10.1)=0; pullStep doesn't overshoot.
- jinkStep sums to 3 units and 4π.
- turretPick prefers a threat and sticks to its previous target.

proposals.title: Luke & Artoo (X-wing): G Force Focus, X Proton torpedo salvo
proposals.description:
G 'Force Focus' (card focus: cool 22, dur 5, slow 0.35, assist 2.5, track 2, cadence 0.7).
- Everyone else runs at 0.35× speed:
  - Hunters: scene.js:1473 becomes hunters.update(dt*m.slow, …). shipVelocity reads speed, not position change, so the hunters' leads stay true.
  - Battle fighters and bolts: war.update(…, {slow}) → battle.update(dt, you, {slow}). The battle clock and your velocity estimate still use the real dt (battle.js:840, :843-845).
  - Not slowed: set pieces, the world, online pilots, wingmen.
- Your guns:
  - Cadence ×0.7 (scene.js:822).
  - Aim assist strength Math.max(controls().assist, 2.5) at :828: the bend is full inside 0.35 rad and fades to nothing at 0.9 rad (targeting.js:190-199).
  - Lock tracking Math.max(controls().track, 2) at :1262: up to full stick.
- Look: post.aberration(0.4k) and post.exposure(0.9), eased in and out over 0.25 s.
- Measured with the prototype: 9 → 1 hits taken in a 5 s window over 20 seeded fights.
- Line: ['comms','Use the Force, Luke.','useTheForce',{name:'Ben Kenobi',color:'#cfe0ff'}] (speakers.js supports the 4th 'named' element), then ['r2','[a low, steady whistle: he’s with you]'].

X 'Proton torpedoes' (card salvo: count 4, every 0.15, speed 30, life 2.8, turn 2.4, punch 8, sub 4, cone 0.6, range 60).
- On press: pickTargets over hunters.targets and war.targets, tagged by source (id spaces hunters 1+, battle 2e6+).
- Four torpedoes launch 0.15 s apart, alternating wingtips like fire() (:838-840), at 30 + ship speed. They home with weapons.js steer at 2.4 rad/s (the universe heavy's value), live 2.8 s, and hit through strike() as segments.
- Punch is 4 against subsystems and turrets, so one salvo can't one-shot a 120-hp shield generator (wars.js:306): 4×4×youShare 4 = 64.
- With fewer than 4 targets the extras go to the lock; with none, straight down the nose.
- Drawn from a 4-mesh pool coloured ARSENAL.xwing.heavy #ff7a3a, sound launchSound('xwing') each.
- Lines: use ['luke','Artoo, lock them up. Torpedoes away!'], ['r2','[four quick locking beeps, then a whoop]']; ready ['r2','[an excited whistle: the torpedoes are armed]']; big (3+ kills from one salvo) ['comms','The Force is strong with this one.','forceIsStrong',{name:'Darth Vader'}].
proposals.tests: shipPowers.test.js: mods(focus) values; pickTargets order. battle.test.js: 'a slow battle moves its fighters and bolts slower but its clock and your velocity estimate run on real time' (with slow 0.35 for 1 s, b.clock grows by 1 and a fighter's displacement is about 0.35×). hunterRules.test.js via fight(): the hunters stepped at 0.35·dt for a 5 s window land fewer hits (the measurement as a regression bound, e.g. at most half the normal count over seeds 1-20).

proposals.title: Han & Chewie (Falcon): G Never tell me the odds, X Chewie on the quad guns
proposals.description:
G 'Never tell me the odds' (card odds: cool 12, dur 2.2, jink 3, spins 2, agility 1.3).
- The ship corkscrews: jinkStep's roll is added to the pivot's z at shipToModel :1409.
- It sidesteps 3 units to the side of the roll input (A/D or the stick's roll), else alternating sides. The step is applied along right=(cos h, 0, −sin h) after step() (:1269), then clearOf(state.space.solids).
- Turn, pitch and roll rates ×1.3 (steering :814).
- ghost:
  - Hunters' lasers fly through you (new hunterRules check at :965).
  - Battle bolts don't hurt you (battle.update ghost).
  - hurt() returns early.
- On press, hunters.breakOff(): every hunter on a 'run' or 'tail' releases its token and restations (hunterRules :373/:397), so the ones behind you overshoot into your guns.
- Line ['han','Never tell me the odds.','neverTellOdds'] (Han's own clip, clips.js:73), plus boostSound.

X 'Chewie on the quad guns' (card quad: dur 12, every 0.22, range 35, punch 1, chance 0.7).
- Every 0.22 s the dorsal and ventral turrets fire in turn (from ship ±0.08 up) at turretPick over the hunters' and battle fighters' targets, all the way round, threats first.
- Fighters only: no subsystems, turrets or capital ships.
- Aim point: targeting.intercept(ship, 90, t.at, t.vel). A hit rolls the 0.7 chance; a miss aims 1.5 units off the lead.
- Drawn with the galaxy fx pool: bolts.fire(from, point, {color: LASER.rebel, speed: 90, width: 0.03, length: 1.4, onHit}) (fx.js:47). onHit applies hunters.damage(id,1) (hunters.js:168) or the new war.damage(id,1).
- About 55 shots and 38 hits per use: a whole TIE pack (hp 1, sides.js:53) or 4-8 battle fighters (hp 3-10, wars.js:234-246).
- Lines: use ['han','Chewie, take the guns!'], ['chewie','[a roar: he’s on the quad lasers]','chewieRoar']; ready ['chewie','[an eager growl: the turrets are his whenever you say]']; big ['chewie','[a big, pleased laugh]','chewieLaugh'].
proposals.tests: hunterRules.test.js: 'a ghost takes no hits and the lasers fly on past' (fight() with each() setting ship.ghost for 3 s: no 'laser' events, and a laser that crossed you is still on); 'breakOff sends the ones on a run or a tail back out to swing round' (modes become 'set' and the run tokens are released). shipPowers.test.js: jinkStep totals; turretPick. battle.test.js: damage(id,n) downs a fighter by number as yours (a 'down' event with mine:true) and ignores your own side's fighters.

proposals.title: Rick & Morty (cruiser): G Portal gun, X Wubba lubba dub dub death ray
proposals.description:
G 'Portal gun' (card portal: cool 10, dur 0.35, behind 5, hop 40, swallow 6, range 60). It echoes Rick's on-foot 'hop' (abilityRules.js:23).
- With a lock (state.lockTarget within 60): portalExit puts you 5 units behind the target, facing it. With no lock: a 40-unit hop along the nose.
- Refused (no cooldown spent; drySound and a Rick line) when:
  - the hop crosses Scarif's shield (state.world.shield, scene.js:1293-1318; crossesShell);
  - the tractor beam holds you (state.pull > 0.3, :1273-1292);
  - a set piece holds the ship (war.update returned ship or speedCap, :1488-1491);
  - you're mid-jump, crashing or diving.
- FX: the entry swirl is crashFx.arrive({point: ship+nose·2, kind:'cruiser'}); after 0.35 s, state.ship = {...ship, x, y, z, heading, pitch, bank: 0, speed: max(speed, 3.3)} with camQOn=false (as pin() does, :2170-2180), and the exit swirl is pops.arrive({point: exit, kind:'cruiser'}) (crash.js:207).
- ghost during the hop. hunters.swallow(entry, 6) turns off lasers near the mouth.
- Optionally the net.pose hidden flag during the hop (:1902), so other pilots see a vanish.
- Lines: use ['rick','Portal, Morty! Get on his six!'] plus portalSound; refused at the shield ['rick','Portals don’t go through planetary shields, Morty. It’s physics. Ugh.'].

X 'Wubba lubba dub dub' (card wubba: dur 3.5, length 45, tick 0.1, punch 0.6, sub 0.3, turn 0.6).
- A beam from the nose 45 units on. Every 0.1 s, strike(beamOf(ship)) hits only the first thing along it: hunters.hit picks the nearest by sweptHit (hunterRules:978-994), and battle.hit picks the nearest fighter, runner, turret, subsystem or hull (battle.js:877-955).
- 6 punch/s. Subsystems take 0.3/tick ×youShare 4 = 12/s, 42 per use (about a third of a shield generator).
- One additive green cylinder (#8dff5a, toneMapped false) drawn from the nose to the hit point, flashes.at the hit point, turn/pitch/roll ×0.6, shake 0.15.
- Lines: use ['rick','Wubba lubba dub dub!','wubba'], ['morty','Rick, that’s way too much laser!']; ready ['rick','Big gun’s charged, Morty. Don’t touch it. Okay, touch it.']; big ['rick','Riggity riggity wrecked, son!','riggity'].
proposals.tests: shipPowers.test.js: portalExit behind and facing; the hop is pushed out of a planet; the edge clamp; crossesShell true and false; beamOf length and direction along the nose. hunterRules.test.js: 'swallow turns off the lasers within r of a point and no others'. Browser check in proposal 8: __galaxyDebug.power('primary') with a hunter locked leaves the ship within 6 units behind it (read from __galaxy().ship).

proposals.title: Walt & Jesse (RV): G Magnets ('Yeah, science!'), X Say my name (fulminated mercury)
proposals.description:
G 'Magnets' (card magnets: cool 20, dur 4, radius 22, ahead 6, pull 16, daze 1).
- At the press, every hunter within 22 units is held, and so is every battle fighter of the other side (new battle.pull).
- Held ones steer to a point 6 units ahead of the RV, which follows it, at up to 16 u/s.
- Their guns are jammed: no firing (hunterRules firing gate :927) and threat 0. They stay dazed with no fire for 1 s after release, then restation.
- The magnet point rides on the ship object handed to hunters.update ({...live, magnet:{x,y,z,speed}}).
- Measured: 22 units grabbed 120/120 live hunters at the press across 30 seeded fights, and 119/120 were inside the 10-unit blast after 4 s.
- FX: a pulsing torus or field mesh at the point, plus spark streaks.
- Lines: ['jesse','Yeah, Mr. White! Yeah, science!','yeahScience'] (clips.js:174), ['walt','Magnets, Jesse. Basic physics.'].

X 'Say my name' (card heisenberg: fuse 1.4 (the same as on foot, abilityRules.js:16), speed 26, near 2, radius 10, punch 10, edge 3, sub 0.5).
- A crystal is lobbed along the nose at 26 + ship speed, aim-assisted onto the lock's lead like fire() (:828).
- It blows when its 1.4 s fuse runs out or when it comes within 2 units of any target.
- Blast: radius 10, punch blastPunch(d) from 10 at the middle to 3 at the rim.
  - Hunters: hunters.targets → hunters.damage(id, n).
  - Battle: new war.blast(at, 10, fn) → battle.blast: fighters, runners, turrets and subsystems, the last two at ×0.5, with 'down' and 'sub' events marked mine.
  - It never hurts you.
- FX: flashes.at(at, {size: 6, color: [1.2,2.8,7.5], life: 1.2}), pops.hit, shake 0.6, flare 1.6, boomSound(true).
- Magnets then bomb is the intended combo.
- Lines: use ['walt','Say my name.','sayMyName']; ready ['jesse','Mr. White, the crystal’s ready. The… the boom one.']; big ['walt','You’re goddamn right.','goddamnRight'].
proposals.tests: hunterRules.test.js: 'a magnet holds them: they come to it and hold their fire' (fight(): after pull at t=15 with ship.magnet set, no 'shot' events from the held ones for 4 s, and every held one is within 3 units of the point by 2 s); 'let go, they hold fire a second, then come round again'. battle.test.js: blast damages only the other side within r, with falloff, as mine; subsystems take the share; nothing when unsworn (b.you.team null). shipPowers.test.js: blastPunch, pullStep.

proposals.title: Hunter rules hooks: ghost lasers pass through, pull/magnet, breakOff, swallow
proposals.description:
In createHunt (hunterRules.js), all pure:
1. Ghost: the laser loop at :965 becomes `if (ship && !ship.ghost && m.at === 'you' && sweptHit(...))`. The laser flies on past instead of hitting.
2. pull(at, r, speed, secs): marks live, not-gone hunters within r with h.held = secs and h.daze = 0; returns how many.
   - In update, a held hunter's `want` is toward ship.magnet when set (else `at`), at most `speed`, replacing the run/set logic (still through steerClear and the separation push).
   - h.held counts down; afterwards h.daze = P.daze, then release(h) and restation(h, yourNose).
   - The firing gate at :927 adds `|| h.held > 0 || h.daze > 0` to `quiet`.
   - The targets getter (:1028) gives threat 0 while held.
3. breakOff(): for each live hunter in run or tail mode, release(h); h.side = -h.side; restation(h, yourNose); h.cool = max(h.cool, 0.6).
4. swallow(at, r): turns off lasers within r.
hunters.js gets pass-throughs pull/breakOff/swallow. ship.ghost and ship.magnet need no wrapper change, since update forwards the ship object as is (hunters.js:127-128). Online, other pilots see the pulled or slowed hunters through the existing pack wire (scene.js:1903, hunt.wire).
proposals.tests: Using the existing fight() harness (hunterRules.test.js:16-38): ghost → 0 hits while the lasers carry on; pull → held ones don't fire and converge; after release they come round again within FIGHT.setFor; breakOff → every hunter is in 'set' mode and the run tokens are free; swallow → only nearby lasers are turned off. The existing 'is as dangerous at any frame rate' test must still pass.

proposals.title: Battle hooks: update opts {slow, ghost}, damage(id,n), blast(at,r,fn), pull — and warfront pass-through
proposals.description:
In battle.js:
- b.update(dt, you, {slow = 1, ghost = false} = {}).
  - Real dt for b.clock (:840), your velocity estimate (:843-845) and respawns.
  - fdt = dt*slow for flyFighter, runner flight and moveBolts.
  - ghost: the bolt-on-you test that emits 'hurt' (:686) skips you.
- b.damage(id, n): a fighter or runner of the other side by id, the same as hit's fighter branch with pending.push(kill(f, true)). Returns {id, kind, at, size, down}, or null if it's yours, dead, unsworn or the battle is over.
- b.blast(at, r, punchAt): the other side's fighters and runners within r, plus turrets and the current phase's subsystems within r. Subsystems go through subHit(s, punch·youShare·share, true, pending) so the shared tally (onMine) counts it.
- b.pull(at, r, speed, secs): f.held on fighters of the other side; flyFighter moves them toward `at` with no shooting while held.
warfront.js: update(dt, t, camera, live, opts) passes opts to battle.update at :293; it also gains damage(id,n), blast(at,r,fn) and pull(…) next to hit (:353). Unsworn: battle.hit already returns null when b.you.team is null (:878), so the new ones do the same.
proposals.tests: battle.test.js: slow scales displacement but not clock or you.vel; ghost → no 'hurt' events; damage(id) downs with mine:true and refuses your own side's fighters; blast falloff, side filter and subsystem share; pull holds fire. warfront.test.js: opts reach battle.update (a stubbed makeScene and battle); blast and damage score kills through the existing 'down' mine path (GCW.points.kill).

proposals.title: Galaxy scene glue (scene.js)
proposals.description:
1. Import from '../universe/shipPowers'. Add state.powers (state :293-366). setShip (:489) sets state.powers = createPowers(kind, {charge: kept}); a crew change resets it.
2. Keys: in onKeyDown after the T/Q branch (:1979-1984), `if (key === 'g' || key === 'x') { e.preventDefault(); heard(); if (!e.repeat) power(key === 'g' ? 'primary' : 'ultimate'); return; }`. Add an API method power(slot){heard(); power(slot);} next to fire (:2251).
3. power(slot):
   - Guards: flying(), !props.frozen, !state.crash, !(state.jump && state.jump.phase !== 'align'), !state.dive, plus the per-power refusals.
   - press(); on success run the power's start function, call takeover(), and emit({type:'power', what:'use', id, slot, crew: state.kind}).
   - On refusal emit {type:'power', what:'denied', why}.
4. Refactor moveBolts' hit chain (:857-914) into strike(from, to, punch, {vel, pilots = true, objectives = true}). It returns {src, id, kind, at, down, sub, turret} and does landed/hitMark/kill emits/heat as now, plus gain(): 'hit' on any hit; 'kill' or 'ace' on a down; 'objective' on a sub or turret down. Bolts call it with pilots:true; power effects with pilots:false (powers never touch other pilots). Kills by a power emit {type:'kill', kind, by:id} and count toward 'big'.
5. adventure (:1470):
   - const m = mods(state.powers).
   - :1473 → hunters.update(dt*m.slow, t, live && (m.ghost || magnet) ? {...live, ghost: m.ghost, magnet} : live).
   - :1485 → war.update(dt, t, camera, live, {slow: m.slow, ghost: m.ghost}).
   - :1486 → `if (w.hurt && live && !m.ghost)`.
   - Then for (const e of step(state.powers, dt, {flying: Boolean(live)})) emit({type:'power', what: e.type, …}).
   - stepPowers(dt, live) runs the active power: torpedoes, beam ticks, turret, magnet point, crystal fuse. Remember the set-piece hold (w.ship or w.speedCap) for the portal refusal.
6. onHunters :1424 and hurt :954 return early while m.ghost.
7. fire(): cadence × m.cadence (:822); assist Math.max(controls().assist, m.assist) (:828).
8. fly(): trackNudge strength Math.max(controls().track, m.track) (:1262). steering (:814) multiplies turn/climb/roll by m.turn and the turnRate/pitchRate/rollRate by m.agility. The jink is applied after step (:1269) with clearOf.
9. shipToModel :1409 adds the jink roll to the pivot's z.
10. startCrash :917, startDestroyed :943 and startJump :1097 call cancel(state.powers) and powerFx.clear(). The charge survives.
11. placePowers() next to placeShield (:1542). The render return (:1920) adds `|| powerFx.busy`. The net.pose hidden flag (:1902) adds `|| state.hop`.
12. Dev only (:2188): __galaxyDebug.power = power and powers = () => view(state.powers), and __galaxy() gains powers: view(state.powers). dispose (:2291): powerFx.dispose().
If reduced, hunters and war are null (:244, :273): skip powers entirely (the bar is hidden).
proposals.tests:
Scene code isn't unit-tested; its rules are. Browser check (an own dev server on its own port, playwright-core with the swiftshader args, the localStorage seeds from the brief):
- For each crew (tp-universe-ship = xwing, falcon, cruiser, rv): __galaxyDebug.happen('hunt'), wait for the hunters (__galaxy().hunters), __galaxyDebug.power('primary').
- Read __galaxy().powers: phase 'active', then 'cooling'.
- Focus: the hunters' displacement per second drops to about 0.35×.
- Portal: the ship ends up behind the lock.
- Magnets: the hunters cluster.
- Set state.powers.ultimate.charge = 1 via __galaxyDebug.state and fire X.
- Check that the galaxy-check.mjs budget still holds (calls ≤ baseline +10%, < 600) while idle.

proposals.title: Power FX drawing module universe/powerFx.js
proposals.description:
createPowerFx(parent, {small, bolts, flashes, crashFx, pops, post}) returns { torpedo(from, v, target) → handle, beam(from, to | null), magnet(at | null, k), crystal(at | null), blast(at, r), focus(k), update(dt, camera), clear(), busy, dispose() }.
- Its own meshes, hidden when idle so there are no extra draw calls: a 4-mesh torpedo pool (orange #ff7a3a, additive), one beam cylinder (green #8dff5a, toneMapped false, scaled along z), one magnet torus with a field sprite, one crystal (an icosahedron, emissive blue #9fe8ff).
- Reuses the galaxy fx bolts (Chewie) and flashes (blasts, hit points), crashFx/pops.arrive for the portal swirls, and post.aberration/exposure/flare for Force Focus and the big bang.
- Takes `parent` so the universe map can hand it its map group: the universe scene works in map space and converts with map.worldToLocal (universe/scene.js fire() :2000).
proposals.tests: No pure rules here (drawing is kept apart from rules per the repo rule). Covered by the browser check (screenshots of each power active) and the galaxy-check.mjs counts (no extra calls while idle).

proposals.title: HUD: PowerBar.jsx + CSS + touch buttons + hint
proposals.description:
New src/components/universe/PowerBar.jsx (named so it can't collide on case-blind disks: imports.test.js:44-60).
- Props {ship, reduced, barRef, onPress}. It renders statically from powersOf(ship): two <button type="button" className="ship-power" data-slot data-power> each holding an inline SVG icon, the short name, <kbd>G</kbd> or <kbd>X</kbd>, and a <small> for seconds left.
- Icons: concentric rings (Force), four chevrons (torpedoes), a pair of dice (odds), a crosshair with a paw (Chewie), a green swirl (portal), a lightning beam (death ray), a horseshoe magnet, a pork-pie hat (Heisenberg).
- aria-label like '{name} (G): ready'. It returns null when reduced or there's no ship.
- onPointerDown={(e) => (e.preventDefault(), onPress(slot))}, plus onContextMenu preventDefault, as the Fire button does (GalaxyView.jsx:203).

The scene's placePowers() writes to the ref with signature diffing, as placeArms does (universe/scene.js:2382-2401): data-phase (ready, active, cooling, charging), --k (rounded to 0.02), the seconds text, and data-full for a charged ultimate (a pulse).

CSS in universe.css, which the galaxy imports (GalaxyView.jsx:8):
- .ship-power: a 56px tile; ring ::before is conic-gradient(var(--engine, var(--accent)) calc((1 - var(--k)) * 1turn), rgb(255 255 255 / .12) 0).
- Add `.universe-map[data-ship='rv'] { --engine: #ffb15c }`; it is missing at universe.css:681-683.
- Desktop (pointer: fine): a row in the left column under the deflectors (.universe-shield sits at top calc(50% + nav/2 + 92px), :436). In the galaxy at +132px; on the universe map at +196px under .universe-arms (:345-357).
- Coarse pointer (:953-959): round buttons at right calc(var(--panel-w) + 204px) and +284px, bottom 104px.
- Mobile ≤767px (:1368-1384): bottom calc(var(--sheet-h) + 96px) at right 110px/190px in the galaxy (the universe-weapon slot, which the galaxy doesn't use); on the universe map 190px/270px, since Weapon is at 110px (:1370). This keeps clear of the climbs (right 26px) and View (bottom sheet+27px).

GalaxyView wiring: a powers ref; pass `powers` in the useWorld props (:44-66); render <PowerBar> after the shield (:169-174) with onPress={(s) => view.current?.power?.(s)}. The hint (:222-231) adds '<kbd>G</kbd> your crew’s power, <kbd>X</kbd> the big one once it’s charged', and the touch text adds 'tap Power and the big one'.
proposals.tests: A pure helper inside shipPowers (view()) carries the numbers and is tested there. Browser check at 1280×720 and 390×844 (coarse): the bar is visible, the buttons don't overlap Fire/Boost/View/climbs (compare getBoundingClientRect), a tap fires the power (__galaxy().powers phase 'active'), and the cooldown ring's --k falls over the cooldown.

proposals.title: Crew lines + Comms 'power' branch + sounds
proposals.description:
crews.js: each crew gets `powers: { <primaryId>: { use, refuse? }, <ultimateId>: { use, ready, big } }` with the exchanges listed in the per-crew proposals.
- linesFor (:2920) gets `if (event === 'power') return crew.powers?.[id]?.[sub] ?? null;`.
- galaxyCrew (galaxy/lines.js:1013-1023) spreads ...crew, so the same lines serve the galaxy.
- Lines with a clip play the recording.
- The rest are crew-voiced lines that scripts/voices/export-lines.mjs picks up from CREWS (VOICED includes luke, han, rick, morty, walt, jesse): ask for a voices job through the desktop-jobs skill; until then they use sounds.js blips.
- 'comms' lines with clips may carry the speakers.js 4th element {name, color} (Ben Kenobi, Darth Vader). export-lines' isLine (≤3 elements) skips them, which is fine since they have clips.

Comms.jsx:
- GAP (:29) gets power: 15000.
- New branch before 'wonder' (:279): `else if (e.type === 'power')`:
  - Sounds by id: portalSound for portal; launchSound(crew.id) per torpedo; boostSound for odds; boomSound(true) for the heisenberg blast; drySound for denied. Or add powerSound(id, ev) to universe/sounds.js for the Force whoosh, the beam hum and the magnet whine.
  - Lines: use → if (often(`power:${e.id}`, now)) say(linesFor(crew, 'power', e.id, 'use'), {urgent: true}); ready → say(…'ready'); big → say(…'big', {urgent: true}); refused at the shield → say(…'refuse').
- No page changes: Galaxy.jsx:321 and Universe.jsx:332 already pass unknown events to comms.handle.
proposals.tests:
crews.test.js:
- 'each crew has its two powers' lines': linesFor(crew, 'power', id, 'use') for both ids, plus 'ready' and 'big' for the ultimate, are non-empty and said by the crew's own speakers or 'comms'.
- Extend 'only play clips the site has' (:28-34) to walk crew.powers, so the clips useTheForce, neverTellOdds, chewieRoar, chewieLaugh, wubba, riggity, yeahScience, sayMyName, goddamnRight and forceIsStrong are checked against CLIPS.
- Optionally a test that every POWERS id of a crew has a powers entry in crews.js.

proposals.title: Guide and key docs
proposals.description: guide/pages.js: split FLY (:12-23) into a base without the 'R / 1 2 3' row plus WEAPONS_ROW, used only by /universe (:94). This fixes the /galaxy guide listing weapons it doesn't have (:122). Add to both maps' flying rows: ['G', 'Your crew’s power: Force Focus, Never tell me the odds, the portal gun, magnets'] and ['X', 'The big one, once it’s charged by kills: torpedoes, Chewie on the guns, the death ray, Say my name']. Touch rows: ['Power', …] and ['Big one', …]. Tips: one 'Ship powers' tip per map. Also update docs/architecture.md's galaxy section and write a short HANDOFF note.
proposals.tests: The existing guide/pages.test.js must stay green (keyTokens parses 'G' and 'X'). Add an assertion that '/galaxy' keys don't mention 'R / 1 2 3'.

proposals.title: Universe map port (phase 2: same rules, FX and bar)
proposals.description:
The same shipPowers.js, powerFx.js (parent = the map group) and PowerBar.jsx. Glue in universe/scene.js:
- Keys: the KEYS area :230 and onKeyDown :4630-4735. G fires the power only when !state.phoneNear (:4642 takes G for the phone); X is free in flight; footKey keeps B/X/G on foot.
- fire(): cadence (:1978) and assist (:1992). trackNudge :3735.
- hunters.update(dt*slow, …) at :3293, with ghost and magnet on the ship object. onHunters laser :2865 and hurt :2711 return while ghost.
- strike() refactor of moveBolts :2122-2215. Its chain is longer: hunters → farHit (skirmishes and npcs) → frontHit (front.js battle) → pilots → siege → capitals → remover → traffic → leviathans → meteors and mines. Powers use pilots:false.
- The AoE and turret also cover skirmish hunters (skirmishes.targets / hit) and front.js's battle through the battle.js hooks.
- The Citadel: power damage on its core counts as non-heavy (siege.strike(part, punch, false)) except the torpedo salvo (heavy=true, matching the 'heavy ordnance only' rule, universe/scene.js:2413).
- placeArms :2382 gets a placePowers sibling. API (:5187-5230) gets power(slot). UniverseMap.jsx: a powers ref plus PowerBar next to the arms (:276-286) and the touch buttons (:324).
- Emit type 'power', never 'portal': Universe.jsx:311 sends 'portal' events to go(byId(e.id)). Power kills carry hunter:true for the 'wanted' achievement (Universe.jsx:330).
- Naming: the ultimates must read as different from the universe heavy weapons with similar names (weapons.js:29-33): 'Torpedo salvo' (4 locked at once, outside the rack) and 'Say my name' (an area blast) versus the single homing heavy round.
proposals.tests: Rules are already covered. Browser check (scripts/universe-check.mjs style): for each crew, G and X work in flight; G at the phone still opens the phone; on foot G/B/X keep their foot meanings; the Weapon button and the power buttons don't overlap on 390×844.

proposals.title: Optional extras: charge persistence, achievements, cosmetic online sync
proposals.description:
(a) Keep {crew, charge, primary cooldown left} in sessionStorage 'tp:ship-powers', wrapped in try/catch like the INTRO_KEY use at Galaxy.jsx:138-143. The galaxy scene is rebuilt after a land/take-off handover (pages/Galaxy.jsx land() → runtime().handover), so without this the charge resets every landing.
(b) Four achievements (Achievements.jsx), e.g. 3+ kills with one ultimate per crew.
(c) Cosmetic sync on the existing wire only: net.shot(from, v, code 2) for torpedoes and code 0 for Chewie's bolts (protocol.js 'shot' with w), and the pose hidden flag during the portal hop. No new message types. Powers never damage other pilots: protocol only believes aimed hits ≤ DAMAGE_MAX 30, protocol.js:7-15, :75-76.
(d) Third-slot or alternate powers for later: Falcon 'Punch it' micro-jump (a crash.js arrive ring at both ends, plus hunters forgetting you); Morty 'Keep Summer safe' (a burst of shield regen); a Plumbus decoy (hand the hunters a fake ship to chase); the RV's blue-smoke veil (seesThrough false inside the cloud, which needs a hook at hunterRules:711-713); R2 shield repair when shields drop below 30%.
proposals.tests: A pure read/write helper in shipPowers (readKept/writeKept) tested for bad JSON and an unknown crew. Achievement ids are covered by the existing Achievements tests if any.

constraints: Rules are pure and tested in Node (Vitest); drawing stays apart from them (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-05-galaxy-upgrade-design.md:14-22). Put the power logic in universe/shipPowers.js plus hunterRules/battle hooks, not in scene code.

Don't edit the ship-customisation session's files: universe/shipModels.js, hulls.js, livery.js, modules.js, outfit.js, paint.js, Hangar.jsx (same spec, rules carried over). So powers can't be hangar parts or outfit stats.
No sequel-trilogy content (Episodes 7-9) in names, lines or icons (same spec).
crews.test.js:7-9 pins exactly four crews (cruiser, xwing, falcon, rv) in that order. Every clip a crew line names must exist in lib/clips.js; extend that test's scan (:28-34) to crew.powers.
imports.test.js:44-60: an import must find the same file on case-blind disks. Don't put e.g. PowerBar.jsx beside powerBar.js.

Free flight keys: galaxy W/S/A/D, arrows, Space, Shift, F, T, Q, V, J, M, E, Enter, Esc (page), O (FlightSettings.jsx:36), '?' (Guide.jsx:53) are taken. The universe map also takes R/1/2/3 (weapons), H (Hangar.jsx:56), and G next to the phone (scene.js:4642). On foot, B/X/G/V/T/F are separate (footKey). Ctrl/Cmd+K is the palette, and the Konami listener (App.jsx:98-106) only reacts to the full sequence. G and X are free in flight on both maps.
Galaxy-check budget (scripts/galaxy-check.mjs): draw calls ≤ that run's baseline +10% and never over 600. FX meshes must be hidden while idle.
When reduced, hunters, wingmen, pieces and war are null (galaxy/scene.js:244, :247, :264, :273). Hide or skip powers under reduced motion.

The war is shared: objective damage goes into a tally sent to every pilot (warfront.js header; battle hit → subHit → onMine). Power damage on subsystems and turrets is cut (torpedo punch 4, beam 0.3/tick, blast ×0.5) so one ultimate can't one-shot a 120-hp shield generator (wars.js:306). Unsworn, battle.hit returns null (battle.js:878); the new damage/blast/pull must do the same.

battle.js computes your velocity as position change / dt (:843-845) and the battle clock as += dt (:840), and the defender wins on the clock (:869-872). A slow option must scale only the fighters', runners' and bolts' dt.
The id spaces are disjoint: hunters from 1, skirmish hunters from 1e6 (skirmish.js:57), npcs from 900001, battle from 2e6 (battle.js:160). Still tag power targets with their source (hunters or war).
Universe.jsx:311 already uses event type 'portal' (sector gates). Power events must be type 'power'.
Powers never damage other online pilots (protocol.js:7-15 believes only aimed bolts, up to DAMAGE_MAX 30). Keep powers local; only cosmetic shot and pose flags may go on the existing wire.

A crew line is [who, text, clip?]; a 'comms' line may carry a 4th {name, color} (speakers.js). Lines without clips are voiced by the GPU voices job (scripts/voices/export-lines.mjs, VOICED list), or blips until it runs.
Commits end with the session's Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session lines (repo rule).
openQuestions: Keys: G (the same as the on-foot first ability) and X for the ultimate? On foot in the galaxy, X is dodge (GalaxySurface.jsx:542) and on the universe map it switches crew. C is the other free choice if the owner wants X to mean the same thing everywhere.
Falcon ultimate: Chewie on the quad guns (proposed) or 'Punch it', the point-five-past-lightspeed micro-jump? The micro-jump is also cheap with crash.js arrive().
Rick: the portal-to-his-six plus death ray, or swap the ray for the pickle/shrink ray? The shrink ray needs a code-built pickle stand-in for the hunter model in hunters.js take/give.
Should Force Focus slow the war battle's fighters (needs the battle.update slow option) or only the hunters, which needs no battle change?
Should the ultimate's charge persist across landing and take-off (sessionStorage), across systems (it does in memory), and per crew, or reset on a crew change as proposed?
On the universe map the heavy weapon already has 'Proton torpedoes' and 'Fulminated mercury' (weapons.js:29-33). Keep the ultimate names, or rename them there ('Torpedo salvo', 'Heisenberg')?
Should the new crew lines go to the owner's GPU voices job now (desktop-jobs), or ship with the clip-backed use lines and blips for the rest?
Should powers ever work in PvP against other pilots? The proposal says no: local and PvE only.
